description: The transcripts of Hi-Fi Multi-Speaker English TTS Dataset (Hi-Fi TTS). No recipe reads them. Its transcripts are Hi-Fi TTS's JSON manifests, inside archives that total about 41 GB, and a fetch holds a whole download in memory, so no fetch can read them (see https://github.com/Mearman/keepset/issues/212).
